verdict.rationale: First-party docs say tenant tokens are short-lived, scoped credentials generated from an API key. They embed filter rules that apply automatically to every search, so each user sees only their own data within a shared index. The SaaS solution page adds that this avoids separate indexes or infrastructure per customer. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of tenant-token isolation in practice, and deeper documentation detail (e.g., token generation and expiry configuration) in the pack.
